Subject: MAP draft: Vendor onboarding / procurement - Acme Health

Hi Lindsey —

Thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and next steps: I put together a short Mutual Action Plan (attached) focused on the vendor onboarding / procurement milestone so we can hit your target production date. High-level MAP milestones below — please confirm owners and target dates so we can lock the project plan.

MAP (vendor onboarding / procurement) — proposed milestones:
- 1) Acme submits W-9 + banking details to Redwood / procurement portal — owner: Acme Procurement — target: 2026-07-16 — dependency: internal Acme approvals
- 2) Redwood returns completed vendor setup form and SOW for signature — owner: Redwood (Marissa / Legal) — target: 2026-07-20 — dependency: review by Acme procurement/legal
- 3) Ariba / Coupa supplier registration completed (supplier ID assigned) — owner: Acme Procurement — target: 2026-07-22 — dependency: vendor form + W-9
- 4) PO issued / payment terms agreed — owner: Acme Procurement + Redwood Finance — target: 2026-07-29 — dependency: supplier registration, SOW
- 5) SOW signed and onboarding kickoff — owner: both — target: 2026-08-01

Open questions / notes:
- You mentioned Ariba — do you need us to register in your catalog or will Acme add us via supplier invite? Please share the supplier portal link and any preferred material (we can provide an onboarding packet).
- If Acme needs a tax form, we can provide our completed vendor_setup_form (attached) for you to upload.

Attachments: redwood_map_draft.pdf, vendor_setup_form.xlsx (draft)

Next steps: Can you confirm the 1) W-9 + banking upload owner and 2) whether Ariba invite or manual catalog entry is preferred? If we get W-9 + bank by 7/16 and sign SOW by 7/20, we should be able to start onboarding the week of 8/1.

Thanks – looking forward to locking this in.
– Marissa
Marissa Cole | Account Executive

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear MAP — this is helpful. A few notes from procurement:

- We can upload W-9 and banking details into our Ariba catalog. I attached our requested W-9 template and a secure banking form.
- We will add Redwood as a supplier but prefer that Redwood completes and returns the vendor setup form so our team can validate the fields before submission.
- Our Ariba supplier portal link: https://ariba.acmehealth.com/supplier-registration (I will also add your email to the invite so you see the supplier record). Our supplier ID will be assigned after we submit on our side; I'll confirm the ID once it's created.

Attachments: W-9_Acme_2026.pdf, bank_details_acme.pdf

Target dates look reasonable — procurement can aim to upload W-9 + bank by 2026-07-16, but that depends on approvals from finance on our end.

I'll follow up with the procurement inbox (procure@acmehealth.com) once we have the supplier ID.

Best,
Lindsey
